# Air shell, theme and hooks (`air`)

Always: theme.css + shell.css give every screen its tokens and vocabulary; index.ts gives useLite(), useReducedMotion(), useTheme(), useAirState().

- **Weight**: 1.3 KiB JS (hooks), 4.4 KiB CSS (theme + shell), gzip.
- **Files**: `kit/air/theme.css` (tokens for both themes, lite and reduced-motion variants, self-hosted fonts), `kit/air/shell.css` (`.app .panel .card .item .row .kicker .status` vocabulary), `kit/air/index.ts`.

## Usage

```tsx
import "./kit/air/theme.css";
import "./kit/air/shell.css";
import { useAirState, useLite, useReducedMotion, cn } from "./kit/air";

function App() {
  const { state, status, canWrite, update } = useAirState<{ items: string[] }>("main", { items: [] });
  const lite = useLite();
  if (status === "loading") return <main className="app"><div className="panel status">Loading…</div></main>;
  return (
    <main className={cn("app", lite && "app--lite")}>
      <section className="panel">
        {state.items.map((it) => <div key={it} className="item">{it}</div>)}
        {canWrite !== false && (
          <button className="row" onClick={() => update((s) => ({ items: [...s.items, "new"] }))}>Add</button>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}
```

## API

- `useAirState(resource?, initial?)` → `{ state, status, canWrite, error, save, update, reload }`
- `useLite()` → `boolean`
- `useReducedMotion()` → `boolean`
- `useTheme()` → `"atmosphere" | "pixel"`
- `cn(...classes)` → `string`

## Rules

- State lives in the Apps API (`/api/apps/v1/state`), never in localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB: every mini-app shares the mini origin.
- `save`/`update` refuse bodies over 256 KiB and roll back on failure; a 403 flips `canWrite` to `false` (guest) and the UI must go read-only.
- `canWrite` is `null` until the first write attempt — render controls optimistically, hide them on `false`.
- Theme is chosen by the shell (`html[data-theme]`); read it with `useTheme()`, never set it.
- `useLite()` reads `html[data-lite="1"]` and `navigator.connection.saveData`; under lite there is no blur, no fixed backgrounds and no app animation.
